description: Sakrand Sugar Mills Limited was incorporated in Pakistan as a public limited company on 2 March 1989 and its shares are quoted on the Pakistan Stock Exchange. Its principal business is the manufacture and sale of sugar, at a plant in Deh Tharo Unar, Taluka Sakrand, District Shaheed Benazir Abad in Sindh, with a cane crushing capacity of 7,000 metric tons a day.
sourceNote: Company website sakrandsugar.com — company profile page (incorporation 2 March 1989, registered office and telephone, factory address, 7,000 metric ton/day crushing capacity, chief executive officer named as Mansoor Afzal Subzwari), read 2026-10-17.
